messages.content:
Based on your 3rd-level package:

- Starting equipment and gold
- Additional 250 gp
- 1 uncommon magic item
- 1 common magic item
- 1 uncommon Zip of Arcannabis

For **5th level**, I’d scale it modestly but make it feel like a real upgrade. A good version would be:

```md
- Starting equipment and gold
- An additional 500 gp
- 2 uncommon magic items
- 1 common magic item
- 1 uncommon [Zip of Arcannabis](https://www.dndbeyond.com/magic-items/11801921-zip-of-arcannabis)
- 1 consumable magic item of rare or lower rarity, subject to DM approval
```

My reasoning: level 5 is a big power jump because characters get Extra Attack, 3rd-level spells, stronger subclasses, etc., so they do not need a huge magic item boost. Doubling the bonus gold and adding one more uncommon item feels generous without jumping into rare permanent items too early.

If you want it cleaner and safer, I’d use this:

```md
##### STARTING PLAY AT 5TH LEVEL 
You may choose to create a 5th level character instead of starting at 3rd level. A 5th level character can start with the following:
- Starting equipment and gold
- An additional 500 gp
- 2 uncommon magic items
- 1 common magic item
- 1 uncommon [Zip of Arcannabis](https://www.dndbeyond.com/magic-items/11801921-zip-of-arcannabis)
```

I’d avoid giving a **rare permanent magic item** at 5th level unless your campaign is intentionally high-magic.

children.text: Can you give me a list of acceptable consumable magic items of rare or lower

messages.content:
Here’s a practical **DM-approved shortlist of acceptable consumable magic items of rare or lower** for 5th-level starting characters.

## Recommended acceptable consumables

### Potions

#### Common
- **Potion of Climbing**
- **Potion of Healing**

#### Uncommon
- **Oil of Slipperiness**
- **Philter of Love**
- **Potion of Animal Friendship**
- **Potion of Fire Breath**
- **Potion of Giant Strength — Hill Giant**
- **Potion of Growth**
- **Potion of Greater Healing**
- **Potion of Poison**
- **Potion of Resistance**
- **Potion of Water Breathing**

#### Rare
- **Oil of Etherealness**
- **Potion of Clairvoyance**
- **Potion of Diminution**
- **Potion of Fire Giant Strength**
- **Potion of Frost Giant Strength**
- **Potion of Gaseous Form**
- **Potion of Heroism**
- **Potion of Invulnerability**
- **Potion of Mind Reading**
- **Potion of Superior Healing**

---

### Scrolls

For scrolls, I’d allow:

- **Spell Scroll, Cantrip** — Common
- **Spell Scroll, 1st Level** — Common
- **Spell Scroll, 2nd Level** — Uncommon
- **Spell Scroll, 3rd Level** — Uncommon
- **Spell Scroll, 4th Level** — Rare
- **Spell Scroll, 5th Level** — Rare

Suggested restriction:

> A character may only choose a spell scroll if the spell is on their class spell list, unless the DM approves otherwise.

For 5th-level characters, I would personally cap starting scrolls at **3rd level** unless you specifically want 4th- or 5th-level scrolls in play early.

---

### Ammunition

These are reasonable because they are single-use and do not permanently raise character power.

#### Uncommon
- **Ammunition, +1**
- **Arrow of Slaying**, if you restrict it to a specific creature type approved by the DM

#### Rare
- **Ammunition, +2**

Suggested restriction:

> Magic ammunition is granted as a single piece of ammunition unless the DM says otherwise.

---

### Other consumables

#### Common
- **Bead of Nourishment**
- **Bead of Refreshment**
- **Candle of the Deep**

#### Uncommon
- **Dust of Dryness**
- **Dust of Disappearance**
- **Dust of Sneezing and Choking**
- **Elemental Gem**
- **Keoghtom’s Ointment**
- **Quaal’s Feather Token**
- **Rope of Mending**

#### Rare
- **Bead of Force**
- **Chime of Opening**
- **Dust of Disappearance**
- **Necklace of Fireballs**
- **Potion of Flying**
- **Sovereign Glue**
- **Universal Solvent**

---

## Items I’d consider banning or requiring specific DM approval

These are rare or lower, but can be swingy, disruptive, or campaign-warping:

- **Potion of Flying**
- **Potion of Invulnerability**
- **Oil of Etherealness**
- **Bead of Force**
- **Necklace of Fireballs**
- **Sovereign Glue**
- **Universal Solvent**
- **Dust of Sneezing and Choking**
- **Spell Scrolls of 4th or 5th level**
- **Arrow of Slaying**
- **Potion of Giant Strength above Hill Giant**

---

## Clean rules text you could add

```md
A 5th-level character may also choose 1 consumable magic item of rare or lower rarity, subject to DM approval. Acceptable consumables include potions, oils, spell scrolls, single-use magic ammunition, dusts, elemental gems, feather tokens, and similar items. Spell scrolls must contain a spell from the character’s class spell list unless the DM approves otherwise. The DM may restrict consumables that are especially disruptive, such as 4th- or 5th-level spell scrolls, Potion of Flying, Potion of Invulnerability, Bead of Force, Necklace of Fireballs, Sovereign Glue, Universal Solvent, or Arrow of Slaying.
```
